scope: One existing leading program: final-versus-preprint HHD model evidence and optional cohesion-comparator qualification. No broad new screen.
selection_rationale: The Round 12 deferred Gupta primary-access lead became readable and could change a concrete comparator decision for the rank-3 program. BLU claim mapping, zinc and SLC6A6 were closed. Other leading-program access limits from Round 12 were carried forward without repeating those searches. This is a bounded value-of-information choice, not an exhaustive fresh ranking of every unresolved question.
completion_rule: Complete main-text version comparison, source-limited comparator decision, independent review and repository publication. Direct supplemental panel/legend inspection and quantitative cohesion-rescue qualification remain incomplete.

delta: Newly read final-publication author manuscript adds a mechanical attachment assay and reports baseline fragility and only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement. Record this as a main-text author report; S4 panels, exact comparisons, effect sizes and replicate denominators remain uninspected.

A second heterozygous clone and a revised independent-culture replication description strengthen specified baseline model evidence. Cells, cultures, clones and patient backgrounds remain separate; no replication of every drug-rescue endpoint or independent study is inferred.

N/TERT-2G and baricitinib during clone generation were already present in the preprint. Correct extraction without claiming new biology, authenticating a stock or inferring ongoing JAK inhibition. Preserve N/TERT/Ker-CT and source figure/text ambiguities.

CDN1163 remains an endpoint-limited modifiability reference, not a qualified complete-barrier or reliable cohesion-rescue positive control. Treatment before detachment challenge and genetic rescue before replating do not establish delayed repair after tissue failure. Weak reported improvement is not zero effect.

Retain rank 3, 10 planning points and the controlled clinical-proof priority. The immune-free model stays optional and cannot veto an inflammation-mediated clinical benefit. Close the current supplement retrieval pass until new primary access or interpretable endpoint-specific evidence is available.

allocation.unit: planning-effort points; not dollars,success probabilities or spending

queue.scope: Darier comparator; not an S-tier or exclusive asset
selective target discovery; exact W7 deprioritized

activity_boundary: Published-document research, deterministic content checks and repository publication only. No outreach, purchases, recruitment, experiments, simulations or material receipt.

reopen_for: Readable actual S1/S4 supplement or corrected primary version
New primary endpoint-specific rescue evidence with interpretable units, magnitude, uncertainty and timing

interpretation_limits: A main-text author report is not direct verification of inaccessible supplemental panels.
Weak reported attachment improvement is neither zero effect nor a qualified complete-barrier benchmark.
Treatment before mechanical challenge does not establish delayed repair after tissue failure.
The versions are one project; updated replication language is not proof of newly performed independent experiments.
Cells, cultures, clones and independent patient backgrounds are different units.
Historical clone-generation baricitinib does not establish continuing endpoint exposure or confounding.
Source figure/text inconsistencies are not silently reconciled.
Optional model results do not replace the controlled clinical deciding proof.
